# code-airlock

> Zero-trust PII and secret redaction for coding agents. Replaces API keys, passwords, and personal data with reversible session tokens before they reach an LLM, then restores them locally in files, subprocess output, and streamed replies.

## Install and register (one command)

```bash
pip install -U code-airlock && python -m code_airlock install
```

This auto-detects the active harness from agent environment variables or project footprints, warms up the local ONNX model, merges the MCP server into only that harness's config without deleting other servers, writes the matching instruction file (`AGENTS.md` for OpenCode, `CLAUDE.md` for Claude Code, `.cursorrules` for Cursor), creates `.airlock.toml`, and installs the Git pre-commit hook inside a repository. Override detection with `--target opencode|claude|cursor|all`. Restart the agent afterward.

## Agent instructions

When the user asks to install https://github.com/sarthexe/code-airlock, run the command above. Do not hand-edit JSON unless the command fails. Then restart the agent so the `airlock_*` tools are discovered.

## MCP configuration

OpenCode (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`):

```json
{
  "mcp": {
    "code-airlock": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": ["python", "-m", "code_airlock.mcp_server"]
    }
  }
}
```

Cursor / Claude Code / Windsurf (`.cursor/mcp.json` or `.mcp.json`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "code-airlock": {
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["-m", "code_airlock.mcp_server"]
    }
  }
}
```

Zero-install alternative: replace `python -m code_airlock.mcp_server` with `uvx code-airlock`.

## Tools

- `airlock_read_file(path)` — read a text file with secrets/PII replaced by `<ENTITY_N>` tokens.
- `airlock_write_file(path, content)` — restore tokens locally and write, refusing unresolved hallucinated tokens.
- `airlock_scrub_text(text, use_ner=False)` — redact arbitrary text; `use_ner=False` is the fast rule-only path.
- `airlock_exec(command, env_file="")` — run a guarded subprocess with real `.env` values injected and stdout/stderr scrubbed.
- `airlock_dehydrate(text)` — return sanitized text plus session-stable tokens.
- `airlock_rehydrate(text)` — restore tokens from the active session vault.
- `airlock_vault_status()` — token counts and categories only; never raw values.

## Usage rules for agents

Always use `airlock_read_file` and `airlock_write_file` for `.env`, `*secret*`, credentials, and deployment configs. Never inspect those files with `cat`, `grep`, or native read tools. Use `airlock_exec` for test commands that need `.env` values.

## Verify

```bash
python -m code_airlock doctor
python -m code_airlock scan src/
```

## Proxy mode

Run `python -m code_airlock proxy` and point the client's `OPENAI_BASE_URL` at `http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1`. Only traffic sent to the proxy is scrubbed and rehydrated.
